snippet.title: Waltz of the Wizard | Skully's Unruly Reactions Update
snippet.description:
Skully's Unruly Reactions update brings +400 new voicelines and a whole bunch of new Skully interactions! From entirely new reactions to extensions of what was there before, the update makes Skully feel more alive and responsive to a greater set of things that you do and say.

You'll find things like alternate reactions so there's variety in voicelines, greater commentary on in-world events, greater number of things like impact reactions, extended functionality in how specifically you do things like dunk him in the cauldron and, for the many who have been specifically asking for it, yes, you can kiss him now.

Skully’s Unruly Reactions is a FREE update to Waltz of the Wizard owners, now live on Meta Quest and Steam — coming soon to PS5!

Meta Quest Store (Available now) - https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/2280285932034855/
Steam (Available now) - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094390/Waltz_of_the_Wizard/
PS5 PlayStation VR2 and PS5! - https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007299
